name: x11-dri
description: Optional native companion to the pure-JS x11 package: direct OpenGL ES rendering (GBM/EGL, dlopen'd at runtime) and dma-buf plumbing (udmabuf, DMA_BUF sync, dup) for the DRI3 + Present path. The rendering and dma-buf paths are Linux-only; builds and loads on macOS, where it reports them unavailable.
author: Andrey Sidorov <andrey.sidorov@gmail.com>
